text:
maria: Heads up — opened PR #1452 to migrate tracing hook examples to TraceContext v2 and include a cost/latency breakdown sample. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1452. Please check python + go snippets and link anchors.
jason: On it. Quick skim shows python snippet still uses `trace_hook` param from the old SDK. I can change it to `trace_context` or keep a tiny shim. Which do we want?
phil: FYI the console dashboard widgets section references the old metric `inference_ms` — that will break the sample dashboards. I can patch that.
sasha: Also the SDK snippet should use `telemetry.configure(...)` after the runtime change. Can we add a short example for sampling config and exporting cost tags?
maria: CI currently failing linkcheck — broken anchor to /console/metrics#cost-breakdown (404 anchor). Who owns that page?
jason: I think the heading got renamed. I'll update the link to /console/metrics#cost-and-latency-breakdown and push.
docs-bot: build-docs: Linkcheck failed in 3 files. See logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/logs/7890
maria: I'll re-run once Jason pushes. Also can we add a note about fallback policy for trace exporters (relevant for Dedicated/private deployments)?
phil: Added a small change in the dashboard sample to reference `latency_p50_ms` and `cost_usd_per_token` metrics instead of `inference_ms`. Pushed to the branch.
jason: Pushed link fix and replaced `trace_hook` with `trace_context` in the Python snippet. Also updated the fenced code block language. Example now looks like:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.trace_context.configure(sampling=0.1, exporters=["otlp"])
# attach cost tags: client.trace_context.add_tag("cost_usd", lambda tokens: tokens * 0.0005)
```
Leaving a TODO to add the Go example. :rocket:
sasha: Small nit — for the Go sample make sure the fence uses ```go and include a quick sampling example. I'll draft that and add a comment about default exporter fallback.
maria: Sounds good. Can we merge once CI is green? We should also backport to release/1.2-docs for Dedicated customers. Who can do the backport?
phil: I can handle the backport and open a backport PR against release/1.2-docs.
jason: CI is green on my push — linkcheck passed for the changed anchors.
docs-bot: build-docs: All checks passed for branch docs/1452. Will merge in 5 minutes if no objections.
maria: :thumbsup: Thanks all. After merge I'll add a brief eval checklist for the updated examples (sanity prompts + dashboard sample validation).
